scope: Real-video application of the twelve-gate H3 shoulder-root review and full non-regression contract
summary: The twelve-gate review was applied to the second r2 epoch-1 replication and confirms that its 100 failing frames have both a non-unique left shoulder root and arm-root intrusion into the head/neck region; the complete contract rejects the candidate.
evidence: The schema-2 topology evidence covers all 124 decoded frame digests and all twelve semantic gates; evidence SHA-256 is 4e30d8575e3a2341c82153a9e185dfaadd62860cbb146696415ddd0682fb7ab7.

Twenty-four frames pass. One hundred frames fail left_shoulder_attachment, stable_robot_proportions, unique_left_shoulder_origin, and arm_roots_clear_of_head_and_neck; 82 also fail single_head_torso_chain.
Both topology_decoded_frame_digests and topology_kinematic_detail evidence gates pass, so rejection is caused by measured anatomy and capability failures rather than missing labels.
The full automatic metrics SHA-256 is 255f3721e87c48c1d73b0dc0405f875efe3ca37beb4404dbc9cc84a0ecd134c0 and assessment SHA-256 is cdb60f7552b0a6e6444992ea308526da097c4e7435c7bdafb26b492656e5abcc.
Identity gain, identity floor, topology, matched motion, and action non-regression fail; scene and temporal non-regression pass.
lessons: Separating shoulder uniqueness and head/neck clearance turns a vague body-consistency complaint into two independently countable failure modes.
Complete detailed evidence can pass its provenance gates while the candidate correctly fails the semantic and capability gates.
limitations: This remains one 124-frame 2-D real-scene clip, not physical or multi-scene validation.
The rejected video is diagnostic evidence and not an improved demo.
next_actions: Apply the identical twelve-gate schema to every r3 scale candidate.
